claims: NASA's Artemis 2 mission launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis 2 mission lifted off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis 2 mission is a roughly 10-day mission.
The Artemis 2 mission marks the first crewed trip to the moon since 1972.
The launch time was 6:35:12 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis 2 mission goal is a 10-day mission around the Moon to test the Orion capsule.
The crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The mission name is Artemis II
